answer: EigenTrust scores decay exponentially with a defined temporal half-life, requiring sustained honest service rather than a one-time contribution. A fresh sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming evaluations; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot bootstrap isolated colluders into legitimate influence. Even if operators wander, branch like a vine, or advance like a glacier across identities, consensus rejects them until independently validated interactions raise their score above threshold.
